name: mailbox-mcp-worker
description: Cloudflare Worker serving the mailbox-mcp MCP endpoint and message storage.

scripts.uninstall: wrangler delete && wrangler d1 delete mailbox-registry && wrangler r2 bucket delete mailbox-mcp-mailbox-store

DOMAIN.description: Your **dedicated** email domain onboarded to Cloudflare Email Routing (e.g. `example.com`). Mail to every address on it is routed to this Worker.

MCP_AUTH_TOKEN.description: Bearer token MCP clients must present at `/mcp`. Generate a random string using `openssl rand -hex 32`.

MAILBOX_STORE.description: R2 bucket where received mail is stored (provisioned automatically).

REGISTRY.description: D1 database holding the mailbox registry (provisioned automatically; the schema is applied by the deploy script).
